scope: Acceptance collector correction only; application source and production runtime unchanged.
defect: Controls ignored wrapping and explicit HTML labels; select option contents could become the apparent field label. This impeded reliable control-to-evidence matching.
fix: Resolve wrapping labels and explicit for/id labels after parsing, including labels after inputs
Combine multiple labels and resolve aria-labelledby references before aria-label
Exclude option contents and private form values from label text
Keep control identities, statuses and evidence unchanged
limits: No functional interaction is promoted to passed.
The historical 7369-identity index is preserved, not regenerated or claimed current.
JavaScript-created controls, browser-computed accessible names and external form ownership still require native DOM inspection.
Targeted collector tests were run; the entire application regression was not repeated for this tooling-only change.
